source.title: Functions with minimal critical set: New results and open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with document identifier 1594014; source name sanitized as 1594014. Local index metadata associated the identifier with title "Functions with minimal critical set: New results and open problems".

Could not obtain a readable primary source artifact from the supplied URL. Shell fetch failed with DNS resolution error for zbmath.org; browser fetches for the zbMATH page and API endpoints did not expose readable full text. Failure modes: network_or_dns_failure for shell fetch and metadata_only for recovered resolver/index records.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the exact title with PDF, Hadronic Press, and author terms. Recovered candidates were rejected because they were author publication lists, publisher/book metadata, Goodreads/book metadata, references in later papers, or a different dissertation/paper; none was a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.

No candidate was extracted because no readable exact-work technical source containing the problem statements was recovered; metadata, abstracts, references, and search snippets were not used as technical evidence.
Saved exact JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1594014.json and outputs/latest.json.
